e.summary: **Flowrise HMS Insurance**（Packagist 包 `flowrise-hms/insurance`）**是一个医院信息系统里的**多付款方保险编排模块****——**逐字自述为**「**Multi-payer insurance orchestration module for NHIS and private insurers**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 MIT**、**类型 **Laravel 模块****、**共 **2 个版本**（**最新 **`dev-main`**，**2026-09-02**）**、**下载 **33 次****、**作者逐字为** `Flowrise Digital`**；**仓库存于 **`Flowrise-HMS/Insurance`**（**MIT、**230 个文件、**1,559 KB、**创建 **2026-05-10****）**；**⚠️ 而**它**依赖的三个同级模块**（**core／**patient／**billing**）**全部钉在 **`dev-main`**、**并要求 **PHP **^8.4****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **README 开篇三句**把「**这个模块为什么存在**」写成**一个具体场景**（**现金＋**国家医保＋**商业保险的**混合支付环境**）**；**② **Current status** 一节**分成「**已建**」与「**推迟**」两栏**，**⭐ 其中一条**逐字承认**「**`processed: 0` from connector paths**」**；**③ **⭐ 一次**明确的设计回退**：**提交记录显示**它**移除了 **HTTP 的 **NHIS 连接器**，**改为**只能走**批量导出**（**⭐ 并**在 README 里**说明原因性的结论**）**；**④ **测试与**主数据**都**落在仓库里**（**35 个测试文件**、**含一份 **40,579 字节的**药品目录 CSV**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未部署**。
e.summary_hk: **Flowrise HMS Insurance**（Packagist 包 `flowrise-hms/insurance`）**是一個醫院資訊系統裡的**多付款方保險編排模組****——**逐字自述為**「**Multi-payer insurance orchestration module for NHIS and private insurers**」**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**類型 Laravel 模組****、**共 2 個版本**（**最新 `dev-main`，**2026-09-02**）**、**下載 33 次****、**作者逐字為 `Flowrise Digital`**；**倉庫存於 `Flowrise-HMS/Insurance`**（**MIT、**230 個檔案、**1,559 KB、**創建 2026-05-10****）**；**⚠️ 而**它**依賴的三個同級模組**（**core／**patient／**billing**）**全部釘在 `dev-main`**、**並要求 PHP ^8.4****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **README 開篇三句**把「**這個模組為什麼存在**」寫成一個具體場景**（**現金＋**國家醫保＋**商業保險的混合支付環境**）**；**② **Current status** 一節**分成「**已建**」與「**推遲**」兩欄**，**⭐ 其中一條**逐字承認**「**`processed: 0` from connector paths**」**；**③ **⭐ 一次明確的設計回退**：**提交記錄顯示**它**移除了 HTTP 的 NHIS 連接器**，**改為只能走批量導出**；**④ **測試與**主資料**都落在倉庫裡**（**35 個測試檔案**、**含一份 40,579 位元組的藥品目錄 CSV**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未部署**。
e.summary_en: This Packagist package **is a multi-payer insurance orchestration module inside a hospital information system**, described verbatim as handling multi-payer coverage, claims submission and claims feedback so that billing can be reconciled against what insurers approve or reject. **Measured this round**: an MIT licence, a Laravel module type, two versions with the current one being an unstable development branch released in early September, thirty-three downloads, and a single named author. **The repository carries the same licence and two hundred and thirty files in about one and a half megabytes, created in May and last pushed on the same September day.** **Its three sibling dependencies are all pinned to unstable development branches and it requires a very recent PHP version.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: the opening paragraph states why the module exists by describing a specific hospital setting where cash, national insurance and private insurance are mixed; the status section splits what is built from what is deferred, and one deferred line admits that a counter reads zero; the commit history shows a deliberate design reversal that removed an HTTP claims connector in favour of batch-only export; and both tests and master data live in the repository, including thirty-five test files and a forty-kilobyte medicines catalogue.** **The package was not installed and not deployed this round.**
e.body:
**Flowrise HMS Insurance**（Packagist 包 `flowrise-hms/insurance`）**是一个医院信息系统里的**多付款方保险编排模块****——**逐字自述为**「**Multi-payer insurance orchestration module for NHIS and private insurers**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Packagist 元数据、GitHub 仓库与包内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 为什么要写这个模块，**答案是一个具体的医院场景****——**README 逐字为**「**The Insurance module handles multi-payer coverage, claims submission, and claims feedback so billing can be reconciled against what insurers approve or reject.**」**，**并接着逐字说明**「**Hospitals in mixed-payment environments (cash + national insurance + private insurance) need one workflow to**」**，**下列三件事**：**管付款方规则与**保单关联**、**提交理赔**、**接收付款方回执并与**账务结果对账****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处最值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**多付款方**」**不是一个抽象词**，**而是一个**具体门诊现实**——**⭐ 病人**同时有**现金自付、**国家医保与**商业保险三种来源**，**而**医院**需要**一条**能把这三种**分开记、**并**与**各家**审批结果**对上的**流程**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正是**「**理赔与**账务对账**」**这一主题**在**非保险机构内部**的样子**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② README 的 **Current status **一节分成两栏，**而**其中一条**自己承认计数为零****——**逐字为**「**Complete for operational claims workflows.**」**，**随后列出**已建之物**：**NHIS 批量导出、**NHIA 回执 XML 导入、**主数据界面（**含**费率表及其明细关系管理器、**药品、**G-DRG／**ICD 映射、**会员主表、**服务方资质）与**会员核验**；**⚠️ 而**「**推迟**」一栏逐字列出三件**：**「**NHIS catalog sync implementation (`processed: 0` from connector paths)**」**、**「**dedicated PatientPolicy Filament resource**」**、**「**private insurer connector beyond the generic stub**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**`processed: 0` **这一处写法最值得抄**：**⭐ 即**它**没有写**「**目录同步功能开发中**」**，**而是**写出**一个**可复现的观测值**——**从连接器路径读回来的处理计数是 **0****；**⭐ 读者**据此**可以**判断**「**这条链路**当下**不通**」**，**而**不必**去猜**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 一次**写在提交历史里的设计回退****——**本次实测**该仓库**最近六个提交**全部落在 **2026-09-02 的 **13:00:32 至 **13:01:13**（**约 41 秒内**）**，**提交信息逐字含**：**「**refactor: remove HTTP NHIS connector; claims go through batch export pipeline**」**、**「**feat: block NHIS claims over HTTP API and drop stale schema fields**」**、**「**feat: add NHIS OTAC client and attendance service for claim-check-code generation**」**、**「**feat: add claim/claim-batch exporters, claim global search, and OTAC settings UI**」**、**「**refactor: align member verification with OTAC card resolution**」**、**「**test: add OTAC attendance, client, and token refresh tests**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**其中第一、二条**最有价值**：**⭐ 即**作者**先做了**一条 **HTTP 的**理赔通道**，**然后**把它**移除**、**并**在 **API 层**主动**拦住**「**走 HTTP 提交 NHIS 理赔**」**这一用法**，**改为**只能走**批量导出**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**这**是一次**能力收缩**（**少了**一条通道）**，**而**它**被**明确写进**提交信息**，**并**在 README 里**留下**可核对的结论**（**「**NHIS claims are batch-export-only**」**）**——**⭐ 这是本会话**多次记下的**「**说清改了什么、**说清它不是什么**」**在企业仓库里的**实例**。**⭐⭐ ④ 结构与体量（可核对）**：**仓库 **230 个文件／**约 1.5 MB****；**其中**：**`app/Filament` **46 个文件**（**后台界面**）**、**`app/Models` **14**、**`app/Services` **14**、**`app/Schemes` **10**、**`app/Enums` **7**、**`tests` **35****；**⭐ 按字节数**最大的几份**：**`app/Schemes/NhisClaimAssembler.php` **15,730 字节**、**`app/Schemes/NhisBatchXmlEncoder.php` **12,845 字节**、**`app/Services/NhisAttendanceService.php` **9,111 字节**、**`tests/Feature/ClaimGenerationTest.php` **14,998 字节****；**⭐ 另有**一份**真实的**主数据文件**落在仓库里**（**`database/data/nhis_medicines_list_2025.csv`，**40,579 字节**）**，**以及 **7 个迁移文件**（**命名日期从 **2026_05_06 到 **2026_08_09**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**说明它**不是**一个**仅有目录结构的**空壳**（**⭐ 本词条**同时指出**：**文件大小**不等于**功能正确**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 「**申报格式**」被当作**核心资产写在代码里**——**⭐ 主要体积**落在**两份文件**上**：**一份 **15,730 字节的**理赔组装器**与**一份 **12,845 字节的**批量 XML 编码器****；**并**另有**校验器、**代码映射器、**G-DRG 解析器与**专科代码表****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一形态**对 RIAA 有直接借鉴**：**⭐ 即**在**国家医保**这类**强格式**场景里**，**真正的**工程量**往往**不在**模型**，**而在**「**把本院的账**翻译成**对方要的 XML**」**这一段**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三条须如实标注**：**① **依赖不稳定**——**三个同级模块**全部要求 **`dev-main`**，**而 **`minimum-stability` 逐字为 **`dev`****——**⭐ 即**这个模块**当下**不能**被**稳定地**独立安装**；**② **下载量极低****（**Packagist **33 次**、**GitHub **0 星**）**——**⭐ 本词条**不据此**判断**其质量**，**只记录**使用面**；**③ **构建元数据里指向仓库外的路径**——**README 的「**进一步阅读**」与**状态说明**都指向**仓库外**的 `docs/` 路径**（**`docs/shared/module-status.md` 等**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**在**单独发布**的包里**，**这些路径**不可达**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openimis]] 覆盖**开源医保管理**、**[[cbhi-viability-replication]] 覆盖**社区医保**、**[[kokuho-rules-engine]] 覆盖**日本国保的**规则引擎**、**[[health-denial-appeals]]、**[[cloudhealthoffice]] 覆盖**支付方工作流**、**[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**具体到**加纳 NHIS／**NHIA **v8.6 XML **批量申报与 **CLAIM-it 上传的**多付款方编排模块**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的三件事**：**① **状态栏要**分成「**已建**」与「**推迟**」**，**而**推迟项**要写出**可核对的观测值**（**如**计数为 **0**）**；**② **能力收缩**（**移除一条通道）**要**写进提交信息**与**说明文件**，**并**说清**现在只能怎样做**；**③ **把**对方要的格式**（**XML 结构**）**当成**第一等工程资产**来对待**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有部署该模块**（**未运行任何迁移、**未生成任何理赔批次、**未导出任何 XML**）**，**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**不主张**其**生成的申报文件**符合**任何付款方**要求**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库文件、**README、**提交信息与**元数据**，**未逐行读源码**（**⭐ 结构按**文件名与**字节数记录**）**——**⚠️ 故**「**它做了什么**」**全部来自**文件命名与**README 自述**，**不是**来自**运行结果**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **NHIA v8.6 XML** 输出是否**真的**能被 **CLAIM-it 接收**（**⭐ 本词条**不主张**任何接口兼容性**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**药品目录、**G-DRG／**ICD 映射与**费率表**的**来源与**许可**（**⭐ 仓库里**只有一份 **2025 年药品目录 CSV**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**是否**处理**个人健康信息**、**以及**是否**有**相应**合规措施**（**⭐ 模块名与**会员核验**暗示**会接触**可识别资料**，**本词条**不主张**其**做法适当**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**最新版本与**最后一次推送**均为 **2026-09-02**（**在解冻窗口的边界之外数日**）**，**而**创建于 **2026-05-10****——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**面向**一国国家医保**（**NHIS／**NHIA）**的**多付款方理赔编排模块**，**且**把**未完成项**与**一次能力收缩**都**写在明处**」这一形态**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该模块**是**医院侧业务软件**，**不是**保险人或**监管方**的系统**，**其**申报口径**须**以**付款方发布的**规范**为准**。

This Packagist package **is a multi-payer insurance orchestration module inside a hospital information system**, described verbatim as handling multi-payer coverage, claims submission and claims feedback so that billing can be reconciled against what insurers approve or reject. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the public repository and the files inside it**: **first, the reason the module exists is a concrete hospital setting** — the readme states that hospitals in mixed-payment environments combining cash, national insurance and private insurance need one workflow to manage payer rules and policy links, submit claims, receive payer feedback and reconcile claim decisions against billing outcomes. **That is worth recording because multi-payer is not an abstraction here but a clinic reality: a patient may draw on cash, national insurance and private cover at once, and the hospital needs one process that keeps the three apart and matches them to each payer decision.** **Second, the status section splits what is built from what is deferred, and one deferred line admits its own counter reads zero.** Built items are the national scheme batch export, the authority feedback XML import, master-data screens covering tariff books with a line-item relation manager, medicines, a diagnosis-related-group and diagnosis-code map, a members master and provider credentialing, and member verification. The three deferred items are the catalogue synchronisation implementation, whose measured state is stated as a processed count of zero from the connector paths, a dedicated policy administration screen, and a private insurer connector beyond the generic stub. **The zero count is the phrase most worth copying: rather than writing that synchronisation is in progress, the readme publishes an observable value, so a reader can conclude that the path does not currently work instead of guessing.** **Third, the commit history contains a deliberate design reversal.** The six most recent commits all fall within forty-one seconds of a single morning, and their messages record removing an HTTP connector for the national scheme so that claims go through a batch export pipeline, blocking national scheme claims over the HTTP interface and dropping stale schema fields, adding a client and attendance service for claim-check code generation, adding claim and claim-batch exporters with global search and a settings screen, aligning member verification with card resolution, and adding tests for the attendance, client and token refresh work. **The first two matter most: the author built an HTTP claims channel and then removed it, actively blocking that usage at the API layer and leaving batch export as the only path, and this capability reduction is written into both the commit messages and a checkable conclusion in the readme stating that national scheme claims are batch-export-only. That is the same discipline this session has recorded repeatedly — say what changed and say what it is not — appearing inside an enterprise repository.** **Fourth, structure and size are checkable**: two hundred and thirty files in about one and a half megabytes, of which forty-six are administrative interface files, fourteen are models, fourteen are services, ten are scheme handlers, seven are enumerations and thirty-five are tests. **By bytes the largest are a claim assembler at about fifteen and a half kilobytes, a batch XML encoder at about twelve and a half kilobytes, an attendance service at about nine kilobytes and a feature test at about fifteen kilobytes, and the repository also carries real master data in a forty-kilobyte medicines catalogue for the current year plus seven migration files dated across three months. Together those indicate a module that is not an empty shell of directories, although this entry notes plainly that file size is not functional correctness.** **Fifth, the declaration format is treated as a first-class engineering asset**: most of the code volume sits in an assembler and an XML encoder, supported by a validator, a code mapper, a group resolver and a speciality code table. **For this project the transfer is direct: in a strongly-specified national scheme setting the real engineering effort is usually not in the models but in translating the hospital ledger into the XML the payer demands.** **Sixth, three points must be stated plainly**: the module depends on three sibling modules pinned to unstable development branches and sets minimum stability to development, so it cannot currently be installed independently in a stable way; its usage surface is tiny, with thirty-three registry downloads and no repository stars, which this entry records without drawing quality conclusions; and its build metadata points at documentation paths outside the package, which are unreachable in the published artefact. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover open-source health insurance management, community-based health insurance, a Japanese national scheme rules engine, payer workflow and denial appeals, and one national statistics portal, **while this entry supplies a multi-payer orchestration module specific to Ghana national health insurance batch declaration and upload, which keeps its unfinished items and one capability reduction in plain sight. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **three practices transfer: split status into built and deferred, and make each deferred item carry an observable value such as a counter reading zero; write capability reductions into commit messages and documentation, saying clearly what is now the only way to do something; and treat the payer demanded format as a first-class engineering asset.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the module was not installed and not deployed**, so no migration was run, no claim batch generated and no XML exported, **and no claim is made that any feature works or that any generated declaration would satisfy any payer**. **Second, only repository files, the readme, commit messages and metadata were read, and no source code was read line by line**, structure being recorded from names and byte sizes, **so everything said about what it does comes from file naming and the readme own account rather than from running it**. **Third, whether its version 8.6 XML output would actually be accepted by the national claims upload portal was not verified, and no interface compatibility is asserted. Fourth, the source and licensing of the medicines catalogue, the diagnosis-group mappings and the tariff books were not verified**, the repository containing one medicines catalogue file for the current year. **Fifth, whether the module processes personal health information and whether it has corresponding compliance measures was not verified**, and although its member verification work implies contact with identifiable data, **this entry does not assert that its handling is appropriate**. **Sixth, on the window: the latest version and the last push both belong to early September, a few days outside the thaw window boundary, while the repository was created in May**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a multi-payer claims orchestration module aimed at one country national health insurance scheme that keeps its unfinished items and one capability reduction in plain sight. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the module is hospital-side business software rather than an insurer or regulator system, and that its declaration rules must follow the specification the payer publishes.**
